title: build(deps-dev): bump @types/node from 26.6.1 to 26.6.5 in /packages/client
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. Types-only devDependency bump inside the existing ^26 range. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid; that friction is the point.
behavior_change: None at runtime. DevDependency typings only. Lockfile enumerated by parsing both package-lock.json trees to JSON and comparing every entry under `packages` against merge base 073a7fb4 (400 entries before and after, 0 added, 0 removed): exactly one version moves -- node_modules/@types/node 26.6.1 -> 26.6.5 (dev). undici-types does not move. Dependabot's regeneration had ALSO flipped the `peer` flag on 16 entries with unchanged versions (removed from eslint, typescript, vue, vite, happy-dom, postcss, acorn, browserslist, picomatch, @vue/compiler-dom, @typescript-eslint/parser; added to vue-eslint-parser, its 3 nested deps, and @types/esrecurse). That is npm-version churn, not part of the bump: npm 11.6.1 run on the same package.json regenerates the base/main flags exactly. It is reverted in this PR so the lockfile diff is the bump and nothing else.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares @types/node ^26.6.5 (was ^26.6.1). packages/client/package-lock.json resolves @types/node 26.6.5 (root devDependencies range + the one package entry: version, resolved, integrity). No other lockfile line differs from the merge base.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. The bump is open as PR #432 and both CBSP21 gates fail there for want of a manifest of its own; this is that manifest.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No production dependency. No source file. No build, lint or test configuration. The Node engines range stays ^20.19.0 || >=22.22.2. Lockfile `peer` flags stay as on main (Dependabot's churn reverted).

commands_run: python bump_audit.py <worktree> @types/node -> 400->400 entries, 0 added, 0 removed; version moved: @types/node 26.6.1->26.6.5 only; 16 peer-flag-only entries; npm integrity for 26.6.5 == lockfile; resolved from registry.npmjs.org; publisher types <ts-npm-types@microsoft.com>; no install hooks; GitHub advisories @types/node@26.6.1: 0, @types/node@26.6.5: 0; git merge-tree onto origin/main d42712e0 clean, 0 sibling reversions
npm install --package-lock-only (npm 11.6.1) on the PR package.json -> reproduces the base/main `peer` flags on all 16 entries, confirming the flips are tool churn

lockfile rebuilt as merge-base lockfile + the @types/node root range and package entry; serializer round-trips the base byte-for-byte; git diff 073a7fb4 -- packages/client shows only the 3 @types/node changes
npm ci --ignore-scripts on the rebuilt lockfile -> added 393 packages, node_modules/@types/node/package.json version 26.6.5
manual_verifications: Lockfile was enumerated by parsing both JSON trees, NOT by reading the diff view (PR #296 precedent: a truncated diff hid a zod 4->3 revert).

Types are checked: client_lint_build.yml now runs a blocking type-check regression ratchet and lint ratchet; lint-build PASSED on Dependabot's head 28a879f9, which resolves the same @types/node 26.6.5 this commit resolves. The peer-flag revert changes no resolved version, so that result carries over.

No `--omit=peer` anywhere in .github, packages/client, or Dockerfiles, and no packages/client/.npmrc -- so the peer churn had no install effect; it was reverted for diff hygiene and to avoid lockfile conflicts with sibling bumps (e.g. #433), not to fix a runtime defect.

files.intent: Declared devDependency version bump, inside the existing ^26 range.
Resolved tree for the bump, with Dependabot's unrelated peer-flag churn reverted.
files.behavior_change: None at runtime. One dev-only upward movement: @types/node 26.6.1->26.6.5. No other entry differs from the merge base.

findings: LOW: @types/node is a ^26 line while packages/client engines are ^20.19.0 || >=22.22.2 (CI provisions Node 22). Pre-existing; this bump perpetuates the mismatch rather than creating it.
architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Dependency bump; no architectural surface. Established by parsing both lockfile trees: exactly one dev-only upward version movement.
